LanguageData.LP_HeroRecord.label: power trait record
LanguageData.LP_HeroRecord.description: Records destiny stages, prophecies, pact payments, sworn foes and legendary deed progress (hidden).
LanguageData.LP_HeroFrostSlow.label: frost sluggishness
LanguageData.LP_HeroFrostSlow.description: The chill of Elemental Touch: Ice slows movement.
LanguageData.LP_ForTheProphesied.label: for the child of prophecy
LanguageData.LP_ForTheProphesied.description: The child of prophecy has fallen; everyone steels themselves for the prophecy. Melee and shooting hit +10%.
LanguageData.LP_FiendishVigor.label: fiendish vigor
LanguageData.LP_FiendishVigor.description: Life drawn from the dead by the patron: absorbs damage taken (value = remaining absorption), dissipates after 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_HurledThroughHell.label: straight to hell
LanguageData.LP_HurledThroughHell.description: Hurled on a tour of the Nine Hells: unable to move, taking burn damage every second.
LanguageData.LP_EldritchTentacles.label: otherworldly tentacles
LanguageData.LP_EldritchTentacles.description: Tentacles reaching from cracks in the ground have wrapped the body: unable to move, taking damage every second.
LanguageData.LP_PatronWrath.label: patron's wrath
LanguageData.LP_PatronWrath.description: Failed to pay the pact; the patron has withdrawn its favor: Pactbound Eldritch Blast unusable.
LanguageData.LP_DeathGrace.label: grace of the underworld
LanguageData.LP_DeathGrace.description: Death gives a little more time to those who have died once: no more blood loss.
LanguageData.LP_WeaveSurge.label: weave surge
LanguageData.LP_WeaveSurge.description: Exaltation of the Child of the Weave: casting costs no neural heat and triggers no cooldown.
LanguageData.LP_DivineBlessing.label: sword of justice
LanguageData.LP_DivineRespite.label: death halted
LanguageData.LP_DivineRespite.description: Kelemvor's miracle: wounds no longer bleed.
